purpose: Template for RAIQ-200M production pretraining corpus approval.
required_before_training: Every source record must state provenance, license basis, retrieval date, hash, and allowed use.
Every source must pass a documented licensing review.
Quality, deduplication, and benchmark-contamination reports must be completed.
Training, validation, and benchmark material must be split under a recorded policy.
The approval record must be completed by an authorized project owner.
